section_header: EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEMS — Dash Pot (DP) System
title: INSPECTION OF VTV

content.description: Exploded view diagram showing VTV (Vacuum Transmitting Valve) components including filter and VTV assembly

content.text: 1. CHECK AND CLEAN FILTER ON VTV

items: (a) Check the filter for contamination or damage.
(b) Using compressed air, clean the filter.

content.description: Diagram showing VTV being tested by blowing air into each side, with two illustrations demonstrating airflow testing from different directions

content.text: 2. CHECK VTV BY BLOWING AIR INTO EACH SIDE

items: (a) Check that air flows without resistance from B to A.
(b) Check that air flows with difficulty from A to B.
